abstract.t:
The BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) is designed to monitor BGP running status, such as BGP peer relationship establishment, termination, and route updates. Without BMP, manual queries are required to obtain BGP operational status.
This document defines extensions to the BMP Initiation Message to enable a BGP Monitoring Station (BMS) to discover optional BGP capabilities supported by the monitored network device, capabilities currently enabled, and default configuration parameters.
